issue: Short workload exit can free/purge companion pages while relocation is in progress. Runtime marks the final event cancelled=1 at atexit; original harness incorrectly required zero failed page statuses even for this cancellation.
resolution: Classify cancelled shutdown migration separately; still enforce cap, valid benchmark output and final counter equality. Every live completed migration still requires zero failures/missing/mismatch.
excluded_runs: All five original processes: two foreign-CPU rejected plain attempts, accepted plain/observe controls and the final adapt attempt with the harness assertion. None enter final summaries.
fresh_comparison: Rerun all three modes in short-h16 using identical frozen measured binaries.
